instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: The questionnaire is to be tried out first on (27) ........ people who have no connection with the project.
items.evidence: Twenty, and not on each other.
items.explanation: Marit is planning to pilot with ten people; the supervisor raises the number to twenty and asks that it not be tried out on friends.

items.prompt: Neither the tables nor the questionnaire adds to the word count, because both belong in the (28) ........
items.evidence: Tables and the questionnaire itself go in the appendix and aren't counted.
items.explanation: The report is 2,500 words; the tables and the questionnaire form are in the appendix, so they don't count towards this limit.

items.prompt: The seminar room has been taken away from the students, so they will now work in the (29) ........ on the second floor.
items.evidence: You've got the study pods on the second floor instead
items.explanation: The seminar room reserved for Thursdays has been given over to teaching; the students have been allocated the study pods on the second floor.

items.prompt: The tutor asks to be sent the (30) ........ before the pilot is carried out rather than after it.
items.evidence: And send me the draft questionnaire before you pilot it, not afterwards.
items.explanation: The supervisor's final reminder: the draft questionnaire must be sent to them before the pilot is carried out, not after.
items.flag_reason: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'pilot uygulamadan önce gönderilecek olan (30)' — pilotlanan şeyin kendisi anket olduğu için boşluğa başka bir nesne konamıyor.
